description:
In this world, a small number of superhumans with extraordinary abilities exist.

Ga-ae possesses eyes that can identify these superhumans. One day, Hoban, who is struggling with extreme poverty, catches Ga-ae's attention. 

Hoban needs Ga-ae's money, while Ga-ae needs Hoban's power! As their interests align, the two begin working together to track down superhuman criminals.
